Getting started

MKP (Markdown Markup) is Markdown with widgets. A document, name.mkp.md, is ordinary Markdown with widget blocks where the reader should do more than read: drag a slider, step through an idea, check an answer. Every widget is composed from a small base set (layout, text, a few controls, a canvas), so a document carries no HTML, JavaScript or CSS, and the compiler checks it like code.

Readers without MKP still get clean Markdown: every widget says what it means as text.

Tip

These pages are themselves written in MKP and compiled once, when they were written, to the static pages you are reading. Nothing here runs MKP in your browser.

#Get a release

Every release has the same three files, from GitHub releases:

File What it is
mkp-cli.mjs The command line, in one file, for Node 20.19 or later.
mkp-web-<version>.zip The files a web app imports. They import each other, so keep them in one folder.
SHA256SUMS Checksums of the two. 
v=0.2.0; base=https://github.com/mmujtabamain/markdown-markup/releases/download/v$v
curl -LO $base/mkp-cli.mjs
curl -LO $base/mkp-web-$v.zip && mkdir -p vendor/mkp && unzip -j mkp-web-$v.zip -d vendor/mkp

The web zip holds:

  • mkp.js, the core: it compiles, checks and runs documents and writes their Markdown. Its types are mkp.d.ts.
  • mkp-runtime.js, the core's runtime alone, enough to draw a document compiled ahead of time. The renderers load it, never the compiler. mkp-shared.js is what the two share.
  • maths-engine.js, loaded the first time a document shows maths its build has not already typeset.
  • mkp-react.js, which draws documents in a React app.
  • mkp-dom.js, which draws documents in any other page or framework.

#A first document

Save this as counter.mkp.md. The mkp fence defines a widget, and the counter fence below it places one, with its inputs in YAML:

# A counter

```mkp
counter "A number the reader steps up or down."
  in start int = 0 "where it begins"
  var n int = start
  row gap=m align=center
    press label="one less"
      icon name=minus
      @click set n=(n - 1)
    text "\val{n}" font=mono size=large weight=bold
    press label="one more"
      icon name=plus
      @click set n=(n + 1)
  project md = "Count: " + format(n, 0)
```

```counter
start: 3
summary: A counter that starts at 3.
```

Check it, then build it:

node mkp-cli.mjs check counter.mkp.md
node mkp-cli.mjs build counter.mkp.md --target html --out out   # out/counter.html: open it
node mkp-cli.mjs build counter.mkp.md --target md --out out      # out/counter.md: "Count: 3"

out/counter.html is one offline page that draws the counter. out/counter.md is what a reader without MKP gets, from the widget's project md line.

Open it in the examples to change it and watch it redraw.
